verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SDKs, only programmatic building blocks: a beta Agent Management API with machine-client OIDC auth (gh-2) and a published OpenAPI spec (probe-3) that could be used to generate clients. That gives AI-native builders a documented API surface, but not first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: any official language SDKs (e.g., JS/Python), SDK documentation, a non-beta API, and independent corroboration of building against it.
